name: Sara Milojević
subtitle: Painting & visual art
intro: "I view my art as an active, engaged space - a sanctuary for shared vulnerability, empowerment, and contemporary dialogue on love and resistance."
biography: Sara Milojević is a contemporary visual artist, painter, and muralist whose vibrant practice moves between intimate works on paper and canvas and impactful public art.
seoDescription: Sara Milojević is a Belgrade-based visual artist and painter. Explore original paintings, selected works, exhibitions, and her studio practice.
